Linux interface documentation checked read-only: fork excludes existing PGID/SID numbers from a new PID (https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/fork.2.html, DESCRIPTION); setsid makes the new PID its own PGID/SID (https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/setsid.2.html, DESCRIPTION); kill with a negative group number targets that current group and same-account targets are signalable (https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/kill.2.html, DESCRIPTION). Thus all old group/session members must first be gone/reaped; subsequent reuse is possible, not shown to have occurred.
